_meta_itemized.notes: SAME DOCUMENT AS FILING 27210. The county published one identical Malena Stevens sheet twice - once in its Financial Reports listing as an 'Appointment Report' (this document_id) and once as her 'Primary' report (27210). Both PDFs carry the same three pages, the same cover figures (2,775.00 / 1,500.84 / 1,703.58) and the same 15 contribution + 6 expenditure lines; the two transcriptions were made independently from each PDF's own pages and agree line for line. This is ONE money event published under two ids, not two - the row-level pair must never be added together (the module's CLAUDE.md already records the id pair). ADDRESSES ARE NOT REDACTED ON THIS COPY, unlike most of the county's 2026 publications and unlike the byte-different 27210 copy the county named '_Redacted': the ADDRESS column here prints full street lines. Every street/PO-box was discarded AT READ TIME under the privacy rule; only donor_city / donor_state are stored, and both are read directly off the page (the form's single ADDRESS cell holds street, city, state and zip together on this variant, so city and state are printed values here, never inferred from a zip). The county's 2026 sheet also gives the ledger pages their own 'Full Name of Candidate:' box, filled 'Malena Stevens' on both pages. FILER-STYLE AMOUNTS kept as read: line C2 is written '$50' and line E2 '$276', both without cents; the sums close to the cent either way. THE COVER'S BALANCE ROW DOES NOT FOLLOW FROM THE LEDGERS: 2,775.00 - 1,500.84 = 1,274.16, but the cover states an ending balance of 1,703.58 (all three cover columns). That is the FILER's own arithmetic on a cover cell this module already publishes verbatim; nothing was recomputed and neither ledger side is affected - both close on their own printed totals. SOURCE PROPERTY THE CONTRACT DID NOT ANTICIPATE - ROTATED PAGES: every page of this PDF carries /Rotate 270 (pdfinfo reports the page as 792 x 612 pts while poppler renders it portrait). rowbands.py measures on the RENDERED page, so the stored pct: geometry is correct, but scripts/campaign_finance/make_snippet.py scales its crop by the UNROTATED pdfinfo page size and therefore lands at 77.3% of the intended y. Spot-verification here was done by pre-multiplying y and h by 792/612; the stored geometry itself is untouched and correct. Same property on 27210. A contributor on line C1 is printed 'Megan McKenna', a name that also belongs to a sitting Summit County Council member and 2024 filer in this same corpus - recorded as printed, with no identity asserted.
